payload.title: An open console tab never learns that a new build is deployed: the shell has no build identity check, the edge answers a previous build's missing chunks with index.html, and GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED is thrown like any other error, so after a deploy the only recovery is a manual reload
evidence: infrastructure/docker/nginx/shell.conf:51-56 (a missing hashed JS chunk returns 404 from the shell container)
infrastructure/nginx/droplet.conf:586-587 (the edge intercepts that 404 and serves index.html instead)
docker-compose.droplet.yml:1937 (the shell image is replaced per release tag, so the previous build's chunks are gone)
scripts/deploy/droplet-up.sh:1355 (every full deploy recreates the containers)
web/shared-ui/src/utils/api-client.ts:894-898 (a GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED response is thrown as an ordinary GraphQLClientError)
web/shared-ui/src/components/guards/ErrorBoundary.tsx:109-111 (the only recovery is a user-pressed reload)
payload.rule_violated: Contract rules C1 and C6 and the PKG-42 goal: a deploy or a BREAKING release never strands an open client
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-42, release R1.
